description: bbs-sales quote-desk guards: no renames inside the tree, no near-duplicate buyer folders, FILLED/ is immutable; buyer precedent and open FLAGS injected at session start and again on the first write in a dated deal folder (which also lists quote-log rows older than 30 days with no final outcome for close-out). Each hook ships as a PowerShell script and a Python script with identical behaviour (hooks/tests/parity.py, run in CI). Interpreter chosen by the shell Claude Code runs hooks through (Git Bash on Windows, sh on macOS): pwsh 7, else Windows PowerShell 5.1, else python3. With none of the three, the guard allows and returns a systemMessage the rep sees (stderr from a hook that exits 0 is shown nowhere), so a machine without a guard says so instead of looking guarded.

hooks.command: command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-tree.ps1"; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-tree.ps1"; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-tree.py"; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"bbs-sales: the quote-desk folder guard did not run (no pwsh, powershell or python3 on PATH). This tool call went ahead unguarded. Rerun the bootstrap."}'; exit 0
